chunks: But then their affirming served them nothing after they had seen Our torment. This is the law of God that has prevailed among His creatures, Then the unbelievers went to rack and ruin.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the faith of disbelievers when they see God's punishment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the transition from 'iman' (faith) to 'nasr' (victory) being contingent upon timely acceptance, illustrating the immutable 'sunnah Allah' where divine punishment becomes inevitable once the signs are clearly witnessed. It serves as a warning that superficial belief at the moment of crisis lacks the transformative power of sincere, enduring conviction, leading to the ultimate loss of the disbelievers.
